theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_atm_liminf_density_le_atom
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → f r ≤ unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) * σ (ball z r)) → liminf (fun r : ℝ => f r / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ σ {z}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
